curation.notes: Correlative dual-trap optical tweezers plus confocal fluorescence (LUMICKS C-Trap G2) used to stretch lambda DNA or lambda nucleosome arrays between two beads at ~5 pN while single-particle tracking fluorescently labelled SWR1 remodeler (Swc7-labelled) or its Cy3-labelled Swc2 DNA-binding domain diffusing in 1D; dCas9 RNPs and nucleosomes serve as roadblocks. The force axis is used to hold DNA under tension rather than to measure rupture forces; output is diffusion coefficients.

evidence.snippet: For SWR1 sliding on naked DNA, 4.2 µm polystyrene beads coated in streptavidin (Spherotech cat# SVP-40-5) were caught in each trap, and LUMICKS biotinylated lambda DNA was tethered. Both traps had trap stiffness of about 0.8 pN/nm.

bead_size.note: 4.2 um streptavidin bead in both traps for naked DNA; 4.2 um plus 2.12 um anti-digoxigenin bead for nucleosome arrays

evidence.snippet: For SWR1 sliding on lambda nucleosome array, a 4.2-µm polystyrene bead coated in streptavidin was caught in trap 1, and a 2.12-µm polystyrene bead coated in anti-digoxigenin antibody (Spherotech cat# DIGP-20-2) was caught in trap 2
Lambda DNA tethered at its ends to two optically trapped beads was pulled to a tension of 5 pN, which resulted in a length approximately 92% of its contour length (15.2 µm).
4.2 µm polystyrene beads coated in streptavidin (Spherotech cat# SVP-40-5) were caught in each trap, and LUMICKS biotinylated lambda DNA was tethered
The number of nucleosomes per array was estimated from the length of the lambda nucleosome array at 5 pN force before and after nucleosome unwrapping.
The SWR1 complex labeled only on Swc7 was constructed as has been previously documented (Poyton et al., 2022).

fluorescent_labels.sequence_location: single cysteine placed directly before the N-terminus

evidence.snippet: The DBD of Swc2 (residues 136–345) was cloned into a 6× his-tag expression vector with a single cysteine placed directly before the N-terminus of the protein for labeling purposes
dCas9 was purchased from Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT), as Alt-R S.p.d Cas9 Protein V3 and stored at −80°C until Ribonucleoprotein (RNP) assembly.

applies_to.observable: median 1D diffusion coefficient in the helical sliding regime

source.snippet: The median diffusion coefficient, 0.024 μm2/s, in the regime of helical sliding, would mediate rapid encounter of NDR-flanking nucleosomes at length scales found in cellular chromatin.

applies_to.entity: single nucleosome in lambda nucleosome array

source.snippet: On average, approximately 34.6 nm of lengthening at 5 pN corresponded to the unwrapping of a single nucleosome, therefore the difference in length before and after unwrapping was used to estimate the number of nucleosomes per array.
